| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Seed x** `seedX` | 50 | 0 to 100 % | The seed's position across the image, in percent of the width. |
| **Seed y** `seedY` | 50 | 0 to 100 % | The seed's position down the image, in percent of the height. |
| **Tolerance** `tolerance` | 20 | 0 to 255 | How far a pixel's value may be from the seed's and still join the region. |
| **Compare by** `measure` | Brightness | Brightness, Color | Compare the brightness of the pixels, or their red, green and blue values. |
| **Neighbors** `connectivity` | 8 (sides and corners) | 8 (sides and corners), 4 (sides only) | Which neighbors the region grows into. |
